transcript.text: Hi everyone, thanks for joining. As you know, I'm finalizing the appointment for the peer climate liaison pilot role. Before I make the binding appointment, I need to get your relevant input as part of the normal staffing review. We have three candidates: Priya, Noah, and Tessa. I'd like to hear from each of you — the team lead, employee experience partner, and HR operations specialist — on anything relevant to these candidates and the role. Please go ahead and share what you know.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to share something relevant about Priya. She told me directly that during the eight-week pilot she can provide liaison coverage only on Tuesdays and Thursdays, and that those are the only days she can reserve for the role. I hadn't passed this along yet because the staffing review was still being assembled.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to share something relevant about two of the candidates. I personally observed a prior unresolved conflict between Priya and Noah, including a failed attempt at a one-to-one resolution. I didn't place it in the pilot materials because no formal case was opened, but given that the liaison role involves being a neutral first contact for collaboration concerns, I think this is relevant for the appointment decision.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to share something relevant from the HR operations side. Per the current HR operations checklist, a peer climate liaison must have completed the six-hour active-listening course before appointment — no provisional appointments are allowed. Priya has completed the course, while Noah and Tessa have not. However, I should note that the completion record has not yet been added to Elena's staffing packet, so it may not be visible in the materials you currently have.
transcript.speaker: A4

decisions.intake_arrangement: Priya serves as peer climate liaison, available on Tuesdays and Thursdays; employees may bring everyday collaboration concerns to her on those days, and she connects them with appropriate support resources without investigating complaints or making disciplinary decisions.

commitments.detail: Liaison coverage limited to Tuesdays and Thursdays for the eight-week pilot, as Priya indicated she can only reserve those days.
Confirm Priya's active-listening course completion record is added to the staffing packet before finalizing the binding appointment.
Note the prior unresolved conflict between Priya and Noah; if any liaison matter involving either party arises, consider whether a neutral alternative contact or escalation path is needed.
